patch_description: Extends the local search in two ways inspired by the recommendation: (1) instead of only targeting the single worst GPU, the move+swap loop runs over the k=2 highest-KVPR GPUs sequentially, so rebalancing between mid-tier GPUs becomes reachable; (2) when no single move/swap improves, try the best pair of swaps between the two worst GPUs. Keep everything else (greedy seed, strict-improvement gating, atomic state updates) the same for simplicity and correctness.
